# Vendored third-party code (browser host UI only)

Generated by `scripts/vendor-dicebear.mjs`. The core, worlds and engine never import these files (AGENTS.md).

| File | Library | Version | Source | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dicebear-core.mjs` | @dicebear/core (one bundled ES module) | 10.7.0 | https://github.com/dicebear/dicebear | MIT |

## DiceBear style definitions (from @dicebear/styles 10.6.0)

Each definition is copied unchanged to `dicebear-styles/<style>.json` and loaded only when its character is first shown. Only CC0 1.0 and CC BY 4.0 styles are used (both compatible with AGPL-3.0). CC BY 4.0 requires attribution: the creator and licence are shown in the Avatar tab whenever such a character is on screen, and listed here.

| File | Style | Creator | Licence | Attribution needed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dicebear-styles/voxel-bot.json` | voxel-bot | DiceBear | CC0 1.0 (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) | no (credited anyway) |
| `dicebear-styles/open-peeps.json` | open-peeps | Pablo Stanley | CC0 1.0 (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) | no (credited anyway) |
| `dicebear-styles/moods.json` | moods | DiceBear | CC0 1.0 (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) | no (credited anyway) |
| `dicebear-styles/lorelei.json` | lorelei | Lisa Wischofsky | CC0 1.0 (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) | no (credited anyway) |
| `dicebear-styles/micah.json` | micah | Micah Lanier | CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) | yes |
| `dicebear-styles/big-smile.json` | big-smile | Ashley Seo | CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) | yes |
